_note: ISO 2768-1:1989 GENERAL TOLERANCES — permissible deviations for linear and angular dimensions without individual tolerance indication. Versioned DATA: a published table transcribed once, referenced by the design-tree manifests through a rule's `standard: ISO 2768-1` (the process manifests used to restate this table per node — nine copies, four wrong — this file is now the single canonical home). Classes f=fine, m=medium, c=coarse, v=very coarse; the drawing note reads e.g. 'ISO 2768-m' or 'ISO 2768-mK' (m linear + K geometric per ISO 2768-2, whose straightness/flatness/perpendicularity/symmetry/run-out tables are NOT in this file). LINEAR values are ± millimetres on the nominal dimension in each range; ANGULAR values are ± arcminutes on the angle's shorter leg length range — the deviation is given as an angle, not converted to a length. Ranges are the standard's: lower bound exclusive, upper bound inclusive, except the first which starts at 0.5 mm.

linear_mm.kind: symmetric deviation on a linear dimension (external, internal, stepped, diameter, distance)

radii_chamfer_mm.kind: symmetric deviation on external radii and chamfer heights

angular_arcmin.kind: symmetric deviation on an angle, ranged by the length of the angle's shorter leg
